correctness.rationale: I independently enumerated the 5142 augmented faces by cover containment and performed sparse exact rational elimination directly on simplicial boundaries, without relying on the packaged Morse rank calculation: ranks of d3,d4,d5 are 349,771,780, so H3 and H4 have dimensions 5 and 15. For each omitted ground point, I used one orientation of each of the 60 undirected Hamilton paths, whose signs are unaffected by reversal (both relevant reversals are even). Each chain is a cycle; adjoining them to im(d4) raises rank by five and their alternating deletion sum reduces to zero exactly modulo im(d4). The printed projected matrix matches the computational convention with rows T6,T5,…,T1 and critical cells in mask order; the four-subset projection determinant is -1. This row convention clarifies the presentation without changing the alternating relation. The path construction is covariant with the sign of the induced five-point ordering, yielding the exterior-fifth permutation module modulo the alternating deletion line. The sign-twist identification then gives precisely sgn ⊗ Std6 and its full trace formula. The calculation concerns rational homology at six points, not integral primitivity. Replay python3 -B /workspace/audit_math.py 2; the uploaded verifier was inspected, not run.
